headline: Mercado Libre Partners With Carrefour for 45-Minute Supermarket Delivery
summary: Mercado Libre teamed up with supermarket chain Carrefour in Argentina to launch 45-minute delivery for fresh and frozen groceries, starting in Buenos Aires.
why: Mercado Libre is Latin America's largest e-commerce and fintech player, expanding into quick-commerce against regional grocery delivery competitors.

impacts.name: MercadoLibre
impacts.why: Launching 45-minute supermarket delivery expands Mercado Libre's order frequency in quick-commerce.
